reference_sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  -- one row per category and week
  SELECT p.category_id, w.week_start, SUM(w.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM weekly_units w
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16, 17)
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY p.category_id, w.week_start
)
SELECT category_id, week_start, revenue_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 4
       THEN ROUND(AVG(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2)
  END AS avg_revenue_4w
FROM weekly

WITH weekly AS (
  -- one row per category and week
  SELECT p.category_id, w.week_start, SUM(w.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM weekly_units w
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16, 17)
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY p.category_id, w.week_start
), m AS (
  -- one row per category and week
  SELECT category_id, week_start, revenue_eur,
    AVG(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_4w,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM weekly
)
SELECT category_id, week_start, revenue_eur, CASE WHEN n = 4 THEN ROUND(avg_4w, 2) END AS avg_revenue_4w
FROM m
